):

        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Vendor not found")

corrected_code:
from fastapi import APIRouter, Depends, HTTPException, Request
from fastapi.openapi.utils import get_openapi

router = APIRouter(prefix="/developers/contracts")

@router.get("/{vendor_id}/spec.json")
async def generate_vendor_contract_spec(
    vendor_id: str,
    request: Request,
    partner_registry: VendorRegistry = Depends(get_vendor_registry),
    current_developer: DeveloperAccount = Depends(get_current_developer)
):
    if current_developer.vendor_id != vendor_id and not current_developer.is_platform_admin:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=403, detail="Forbidden: unauthorized to inspect contract specifications for other vendors")

    vendor = await partner_registry.find_vendor(vendor_id)
    if not vendor:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Vendor not found")

    allowed_tags = vendor.granted_scopes
    filtered_routes = [
        route for route in request.app.routes
        if hasattr(route, "tags") and any(tag in allowed_tags for tag in route.tags)
    ]
    spec = get_openapi(
        title=f"{vendor.name} Integration Contract",
        version=vendor.contract_version,
        routes=filtered_routes
    )
    return spec
